Why Telepatia

Telepatia AI is a healthtech company on a mission to transform healthcare in Latin America and beyond. Born at Stanford and built by doctors for doctors, our platform introduces AI Healthcare Employees that work invisibly inside clinical workflows - transcribing consultations in real time, generating structured medical records, offering evidence-based decision support, and integrating seamlessly with any current health system - all without disrupting the physician's flow.

You'll turn vague product bets into answers - fast: define it, build the smallest thing that produces real signal, run it against real users, and make the call. What you prove decides what Telepatia builds next.

What you'll do

  • Take a product idea from ambiguity to a validated hypothesis in days, not quarters. Design the smallest thing that produces real signal, build it, run it, and make the call

  • Kill ideas early. "This doesn't work, here's the evidence, next" is often the most valuable output of the week

  • Build MVPs fast without building throwaway - the prototypes that survive become products

  • Work the whole stack of a product: models, services, data, and whatever thin interface tests the idea. No spec handed to you, no handoff away from you

  • Collapse hard problems into simple ones. That's the skill this role is really hiring for

What you bring

  • A senior 0→1 track record: products you owned from idea to shipped, not projects you contributed to. You can describe a bet that paid off and one you killed

  • Extreme bias to action. Given a week and a vague problem, you produce something running, not a document

  • Judgment on what to fake, what to hardcode, what to skip - and what has to be right on day one, because in a clinical context some corners cannot be cut

  • Full-stack range with real depth in AI: strong Python and enough command of backend, data, and lightweight frontends to ship alone, with the AI layer as your strongest suit

  • AI-native: you code with AI tools daily and get real leverage from them

  • Fluent in English

Bonus

  • Healthcare or clinical domain knowledge

  • Experience in fast-paced environments
